label: SB-12 active-stream memory: RSS per held-open bidi stream at 1k/10k/100k streams
methodology: one fresh server per ladder point; per repeat: baseline RSS, open C idle connections, idle RSS, then open S held-open FullDuplexCall bidi streams (HEADERS without END_STREAM, no DATA) spread at streams_per_conn per connection, settle, streams RSS; bytes/stream = (streams-idle)/held. The idle delta is kept as a cross-check against the conn-scale-idle ladder. Cell order is frozen: peers in file order x ladder ascending.
stream_cap_guard: streams_per_conn tops at 50, below every known peer default (pbrs/tonic 256, go/cpp >= 100); the runner drains each connection for RST_STREAM after settle and marks the cell invalid (not a loss) when >1% of streams were refused.
claim_host_requirements: Linux, pinned 1 CPU for the server, RLIMIT_NOFILE >= 16k, loopback port range wider than the widest base (2000 conns); the report embeds the live values.
os_limit_policy: same as conn-scale-idle: any OS ceiling hit marks the cell invalid, never fail; only fail exits nonzero.
